keywords: 取出;拆下;拆开;拆卸;可拆;可拆洗;洗碗机;dishwasher;removable;detachable;take apart
must_show_en: the removable part is taken off and set aside, away from water and dirt; only the part being cleaned is shown being washed
must_not_en: cleaning while the product is still assembled; electrical parts under water or soaking
note: 拆洗：事实写了能拆、取出、洗碗机，画面必须是拆开的状态，带电部分离开水；45° 俯拍看清拆开的部件

keywords: 清洗;易清洗;好清洗;好打理;冲洗;擦拭;一擦;rinse;wipe;easy to clean
must_show_en: a real cleaning action on the outer surface of the assembled product: a hand wiping or rinsing it
must_not_en: parts taken apart or laid out; the product in a dishwasher
note: 只说好清洁、没说能拆：不拆，只拍擦或冲外表

must_show_en: the trigger moment: a person or pet arrives or acts, and the product visibly responds at that instant
must_not_en: glowing beams, rays, icons or lights drawn to show the sensor
note: 感应、自动：拍「人或宠物来了，产品当场有反应」那一刻

keywords: 安静;静音;低噪;分贝;dB;quiet;silent;low noise
must_show_en: the product visibly running while a person or pet right next to it stays completely undisturbed: asleep, reading or resting
must_not_en: sound waves, decibel meters, mute icons, headphones
note: 安静：产品明明在工作，旁边的人或宠物照样睡、照样看书

keywords: 流水;出水;出风;送风;喷雾;水流;风力;定时;持续;循环出水;flow;airflow;mist;spray
must_show_en: the product's output visibly happening: for example water flowing from the outlet with ripples, air moving fabric or hair, mist hanging in the light
must_not_en: a still, idle product with no visible output
note: 产品在工作时的「输出」要看得见：水在流、风吹动东西、雾在光里

keywords: 水位;水位窗;显示;屏幕;指示灯;刻度;余量;water level;water window;display;indicator;gauge
must_show_en: the indicator or display clearly readable, showing a plausible real state
must_not_en: a glowing or invented interface; numbers or marks added that the product does not have
note: 指示、显示：让它读得清；它在哪一面就拍哪一面，所以允许正面

keywords: 加水;加粮;添加;补充;装入;倒入;refill;fill up;top up;load
must_show_en: the product open and being filled: the contents (water, food or other) visibly going in
must_not_en: contents spilling everywhere; the product shown closed while being filled
note: 加注、补充：拍正在装进去的那一刻

must_show_en: the product in a spot a cable could not easily reach, or being carried or moved, with no power cable in sight
must_not_en: a power cable attached to the product
note: 无线、便携：放在线够不着的地方，或正被拿着移动；画面里没有电线

keywords: 容量;升;毫升;尺寸;大容量;超大;capacity;large;volume;size
must_show_en: the real scale made obvious by a known-size object, a hand or a pet beside the product; plenty of contents visible inside
must_not_en: scale lines, measuring marks, an enlarged product
note: 容量、尺寸：用已知大小的东西作参照，里面装得满

keywords: 不锈钢;304;铝;玻璃;陶瓷;实木;木;皮;硅胶;材质;stainless;aluminium;aluminum;glass;ceramic;wood;leather;silicone;material
must_show_en: the material's real texture catching the light, with fine surface detail visible
must_not_en: a changed colour or material; an exaggerated mirror finish

keywords: 水泵;泵;滤芯;滤网;过滤;电池;毫安;电机;马达;循环;battery;filter;pump;motor;circulat
must_show_en: the outer product exactly as in the references
must_not_en: internal parts that are not listed in the product card's internal structure
note: 内部的东西：可以考虑透视或剖视，但只画产品卡「内部结构」确认过的部件；不清楚就问用户
